rows.collection_note: Over two years. Money paid into court and unclaimed for a year goes to the Virginia Treasury (§ 8.01-602); money a trustee still holds is presumed abandoned after five years (§ 55.1-2514, our reading). Search the former owner's name at vamoneysearch.gov. The owner claims free. A finder may not contract for a fee until 36 months after the money reached the Treasury, and then no more than 10% (§ 55.1-2542).
